stubs.service: Codex CLI + imagegen (`codex exec`, launched by the app's local API for every handoff job)
stubs.how: IMAGE_COCKPIT_CODEX_COMMAND points at .ui-capture/stubs/codex-cli/codex, a local Node script. `--help` succeeds so the runner preflight reports 'ready' (mode 'codex', not the mock-runner path). For `codex exec` it reads the handoff job JSON from stdin/env, waits ~7s, logs like Codex, and writes a real pixel-art PNG named <jobId>.png into the job outbox (best keyword match from the repo's bundled public/prompt-examples art; image-edit jobs return the selected source image). Animation/effect sheet jobs get a standard blocked JSON sidecar (imagegen_unavailable), which the app shows as a failure notice.

notes: Image Cockpit is a Vite/React SPA plus a local Node handoff API (server/index.ts). Setup: node 24.22.3 via mise (mise.toml), `npm ci`, `npx vite build` -> dist/. start.sh runs .ui-capture/serve.mjs on $PORT, the production equivalent of the repo's `npm run dev:all` supervisor. It starts and supervises the app's API (`node --import tsx server/index.ts`, port 4481, handoff folder .ui-capture/data/codex-handoff, autorun on with the Codex stub). It serves dist/, proxies /api to the API, answers the supervisor endpoints the UI polls (/api/dev/health, /api/dev/repair, /api/dev/restart-*) in the same shape as scripts/dev-supervisor.mjs, and injects .ui-capture/seed-web/seed-bootstrap.js. The repo's own supervisor can't be used because it launches the API through the tsx CLI, whose IPC pipe the sandbox blocks. The app keeps its result history, frames and actions in the browser's IndexedDB (image-cockpit-local-state), so on the first visit from a fresh browser profile the bootstrap writes the seed (seed-state.json) into that IndexedDB schema before loading the app bundle. Later visits load normally, so in-app changes persist; ?safe=1 / ?reset=1 bypass it. Data: an indie dev building 'Hollowmere', a pixel-art action RPG, July to November 2026. There are 30 Results (the app's retention cap): Codex-generated characters and NPCs (Rowan the hero, Sera, Wren, Elder Bram, Maren the witch, Dain the blacksmith, tavern cook), enemies (slimes, goblin, kobold, wyvern, harpy, mimic, floating eye, skeleton), image-edit variants (ember and water slimes derived from the green slime), local-file imports with messy names, rejected first tries, and 6 direction-split animation sheets (basic attack, hurt, downed, victory cheer, spell cast, skill release; 240 split frames) each linked to its source character. 16 results are adopted. Server side has matching inbox jobs, completed runner statuses, logs and outbox PNGs, one blocked (policy) job, and 2 results that finished after the browser closed (the Cockpit card shows '2 outbox results available for Recover Results'). Regenerate with `node .ui-capture/gen-seed.mjs`. Main areas: 1. Workflow tabs (Pixel Art Generation, Image Editing with numbered region annotations, Animation Generation with motion presets, Effect Animation), Codex runner and Cockpit health card, prompt plus Prompt Examples modal; 2. Preview (single image, or directional previews and sprite-sheet preview for animation results); 3. Results history list; 4. Download panel; Codex Log shelf for running jobs.
